lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
sections_in_order: Position Statement (Panniculectomy; Abdominal/Gynecologic Surgery; Significant Weight Loss/Bariatric Surgery; Cosmetic/Non-Covered; Abdominoplasty)
criteria_location: Position Statement (pp.3-4): base panniculectomy ALL list; separate weight-loss/bariatric ALL list that re-uses the base; with a footnote-style 'Note' defining 'significant weight loss'.
procedures_covered: Panniculectomy at time of abdominal/gynecologic surgery

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate 'Cosmetic/Non-Covered' section: cosmetic, back or neck pain; abdominoplasty always cosmetic; pannus resulting from a contract-excluded bariatric procedure is excluded.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None. Weight-loss section is a stacked requirement on top of base.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Panniculectomy meets the definition of medical necessity when ALL of the following criteria are met: Panniculus at grade 2 or above ... AND One of the following: ... AND When ALL of the following criteria are met: There is a functional deficit ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three AND-joined blocks where block 2 is an OR of three and block 3 is a second ALL; the 3rd option of block 2 (functional impairment such as difficulty with ambulation) overlaps with block 3's functional deficit.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Symptoms (persistent skin condition under panniculus, chronic maceration of overhanging skin) or functional impairment persists despite *significant weight loss which has been stable for at least 3 months or documented attempts at weight loss (medically supervised diet or bariatric surgery) have been unsuccessful
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or' appears twice in one bullet: (stable loss) or (attempts unsuccessful); and the next bullet is a separate ALL item with another or.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: they are at least 18 months post-operative or has documented stable weight for at least 3 months
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR lets a bariatric patient bypass 18 months if weight stable 3 months, which contradicts the usual rule in other payers.
